newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Makkah Construction Company reached a deal with real estate owners near the holy sites in Mecca to build a giant real estate project.
- The Ministry of Education allocated 525 million riyals to build new schools in Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi Arabia spent around 600 million riyals on expansion projects at Moslems' holiest shrines in Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi, Egyptian and U.S. firms signed a plastic pipe plant agreement at a cost of 44.4 million riyals.
- The governor of Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province signed a water maintenance deal worth eight million riyals.
- Trade between Saudi Arabia and Taiwan in 1995 amounted to more than two billion riyals, an official said.
